scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes the all-integer all-Borel-coupling bound. Reproducibility code checks finitely many cases and is not a substitute for infinite proof. Historical priority has not been independently adjudicated.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two equal-weight marginally uniform circle observations; real finite trigonometric bandwidth m; no general smooth-function, noisy, adaptive, or more-than-two-point guarantee. Support and Fourier cosine moments of optimal displacement are necessary but not a full classification of every nonstationary optimizer. Classical Fejer methods create residual equivalent-prior-art risk.
title: Sharp minimax variance of two marginally uniform samples for bandlimited periodic quadrature
